population.definition: YouTube channels with at least 100,000 subscribers in end-of-2019 crawl

marketplace.comparison: no marketplace links in sampled videos
marketplace URLs on fewer than 20% of channel video descriptions
marketplace URLs on 80% or more of channel video descriptions

crowdfunding.comparison: no crowdfunding links in sampled videos
crowdfunding URLs on fewer than 20% of channel video descriptions
crowdfunding URLs on 80% or more of channel video descriptions

modeled_advertising_revenue_in_article.notes: Authors' 2019 revenue-tier worksheet extrapolates view shares using aggregate ad-revenue disclosure; it is not channel payout microdata.

limitations: Observations concern a historical end-of-2019 selection of highly subscribed channels, not a randomly sampled all-channel universe.
Links are traces of promotion and networking, not payments, sales conversion or causal additional revenue.
Channels can edit old video descriptions, so URLs seen at collection may not describe the original publication date.
Sample included many markets and languages but high-subscriber inclusion favors already successful publishers.
The 2023 article's modeled revenue by subscriber tier must not be treated as observed native payouts.
Counts of videos, channels, descriptions with links and extracted URL events have separate units.
reporting_rules: Never project 2019 linking shares onto 2026 channels without a comparable dated sample.
Do not infer zero external earnings from zero links; sponsorships, memberships and offline income can occur without description URLs.
Do not convert link frequency into revenue, total audience, full-population channel success odds or newcomer earnings.
Preserve channel-level rather than video-level denominators for marketplace and crowdfunding percentages.

historical_view_concentration.population: Source authors' end-of-2019 broad sample of over 36 million crawled channels, not necessarily a worldwide random census
historical_view_concentration.limitations: 2019 crawl-based concentration within the authors' sample. Not a current platform-wide share, not income concentration, and not a 2026 success probability.
